pep_classes.regular: Professional Enhancement Program (PEP) classes are designed for students registered for placements. They offer training in specific skills like DSA, Web Development, and Data Science. Industry mentors often come to teach these classes to make students industry-ready.
pep_classes.cse_special_merit: A special merit-based PEP class is available exclusively for 2nd-year CSE students. It also features teaching by industry mentors and prepares students for placements early, allowing them to participate in campus placements starting in their 5th semester.

edu_revolution.description: Edu Revolution is LPU's flagship program that gives students flexibility and rewards based on their skills, prior knowledge, and achievements. It empowers students to skip redundant learning, earn better grades, and get attendance relief for productive activities.

benefits.RPL (Recognition of Prior Learning): If a student has prior knowledge of any subject currently offered in their semester, they can apply for RPL (Recognition of Prior Learning) and get exempted from that course. This means they don't have to attend classes for a subject they already know — they can use that time for other productive work instead.
benefits.Grade Upgradation: If a student has an industry certification (e.g., AWS, Google, Microsoft), a published patent, or a completed project, they can apply for Grade Upgradation under Edu Revolution. This allows them to improve their existing grade in a subject by showcasing their real-world skills and achievements.
benefits.Attendance Relaxation (MOOC): If a student is enrolled in a MOOC (Massive Open Online Course) from platforms like Coursera, NPTEL, edX, etc., they can avail up to 10% attendance relaxation in their regular classes. This encourages students to upskill online without worrying about attendance shortfall.

attendance_and_leaves.duty_leave: Duty Leave (DL) is granted only for officially announced LPU sessions that explicitly provide it. Students can avail a maximum of 10% of their total semester classes as DL.
attendance_and_leaves.mooc_attendance_relaxation: Students who are actively pursuing a MOOC course (e.g., on Coursera, NPTEL, edX, or similar platforms) are eligible for up to 10% attendance relaxation in their current semester courses. This benefit is available under the Edu Revolution program and must be applied through the proper channel on UMS.

innovation_studio.name: Innovation Studio
innovation_studio.description: The Innovation Studio at Block 40 is LPU's dedicated space for students who want to go beyond textbooks and work on real-world projects. It is a collaborative, open environment where creativity meets technology and ideas turn into reality.
what_happens_there: Students work on live and ongoing innovative projects across domains like AI, robotics, IoT, app development, social impact, and more.
Interdisciplinary teams collaborate to build prototypes, startup ideas, and research-based solutions.
Mentorship and guidance is available from faculty and industry professionals.
Students can showcase their work, participate in hackathons, and pitch ideas.
innovation_studio.how_to_join: Any student interested in working on a project can simply walk into Block 40 — Innovation Studio. You can join an existing ongoing project by finding a team that matches your interest, or you can start your own project and build your own team from scratch.
innovation_studio.team_formation: Students are free to form their own teams at the Innovation Studio. There are no restrictions on team size or department — anyone from any school or program can collaborate. This cross-disciplinary approach helps in building well-rounded, innovative solutions.
innovation_studio.who_can_join: All LPU students, regardless of their program, year, or branch, are welcome to visit and work at the Innovation Studio.
benefits: Hands-on project experience that strengthens your resume and portfolio.
Opportunity to work with like-minded peers and mentors.
Exposure to real-world problem solving and startup culture.
Chance to apply for patents, publish papers, and participate in national-level competitions.
Work done here can be used for Grade Upgradation under the Edu Revolution program.
